versions.changelog: Fix requires.env schema (now string array per OpenClaw spec); switch to mcporter-based MCP integration; recommend engram-lumetra as the server name to avoid collisions with stale editor-config imports; bump all tool selectors in the body accordingly.

- Initial release of lumetra-engram skill.
- Provides persistent, explainable memory for OpenClaw agents using the hosted Engram MCP server.
- Supports storing, querying, listing, and deleting facts using a hybrid retrieval system with explanation traces.
- Organize memories with customizable buckets; store atomic, declarative facts for best results.
- Requires an Engram API key and a configured provider key at lumetra.io for full functionality.
